name: API Tester
tagline: Sends HTTP requests and shows the responses

offers.label: New request
offers.description: Starts a blank request in the builder, leaving the one it held.

offers.label: New collection
offers.description: Creates a collection to keep requests in.

offers.label: Rename request
offers.description: Renames the request in the builder.

offers.label: Delete the saved request
offers.description: Deletes the saved request the builder holds a copy of.

offers.label: New environment
offers.description: Creates an environment and starts using it.

offers.label: Delete the environment
offers.description: Deletes the environment in use.

offers.label: No environment
offers.description: Sends with no environment: every `{{variable}}` stays as typed.

offers.label: Store sign-in
offers.description: Keeps the value typed for the request's sign-in where the workspace cannot read it, and

offers.label: Forget credential
offers.description: Takes the request's sign-in off this device.

offers.label: Send
offers.description: Sends what the builder holds to the address it names, in the environment in use, and answers

offers.label: Send
offers.description: Starts what `send` sends as a job the person at the window can stop, and leaves its answer to

offers.label: Send failed
offers.description: Ends a send that got no answer from the engine, saying why in the window.

offers.label: Settle send
offers.description: Folds what a send's job said of itself into the window, and answers the response the job

offers.label: Cancel request
offers.description: Stops waiting for the service to answer.

offers.label: Copy body
offers.description: Copies the response body, exactly as the response pane shows it.

offers.label: Copy headers
offers.description: Copies every response header, one `Name: value` per line.

offers.label: Copy request
offers.description: Copies the request as authored, with its `{{variables}}` and never a credential.

offers.label: Dismiss notice
offers.description: Dismisses the line under the response.

offers.label: Keep answer
offers.description: Keeps the answer in the workspace, so the window and an agent read the same one.

offers.label: Record sent
offers.description: Adds the request that just came back to the workspace's history, newest first.
